end.summary:
Arjun practised comparing distances by converting them to the same unit.
They correctly converted 2 m to 200 cm and 2 km 75 m to 2,075 m.
They ordered 500 m, 2 km, and 2,700 m from shortest to longest.
They ordered a set of mixed distances, but remained confused when comparing 1 km 600 m with 2 km 100 m.
Teach-back was not passed; the final confusion was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised changing kilometres to metres before comparing distances and used this method correctly in several examples. They also ordered three distances from shortest to longest. They mixed up the kilometre part and metre part when comparing 1 km 600 m with 2 km 100 m, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise converting each distance fully to metres and then comparing the resulting numbers.
